articles.title: The Wreck Of A Luxury Steamer That Sank In 1872 Has Been Found Intact And Upright On The Bottom Of Lake Michigan
articles.summary: After more than 150 years, the shipwreck of the Lac La Belle, which sank off Wisconsin's coast due to inclement weather, has finally been located. Decades of searching by dedicated shipwreck hunters culminated in this discovery, unearthing a significant piece of maritime history previously lost to the Great Lakes. This finding brings closure to a long-standing mystery.

articles.title: Over 650 participants compete in Chinar Open Winter Games 2026 at Gulmarg
articles.summary: The Chinar Open Winter Games 2026 successfully concluded at Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir, drawing over 650 participants across eight events. This two-day winter sports extravaganza promoted athleticism and national spirit in a picturesque setting. Such initiatives showcase India's capability to host significant sporting competitions, encouraging local talent and contributing to national unity and development through sports.

articles.title: Operation Jwala: Arms, ammo recovered near LoC in J&K’s Rajouri
articles.summary: Indian security forces, under 'Operation Jwala', successfully recovered significant caches of arms and ammunition near the Line of Control in Rajouri, Jammu & Kashmir. This operation highlights the continuous vigilance of our armed forces in combating potential threats and preventing the flow of illegal weaponry, crucial for maintaining peace and security in the border region and ensuring national integrity.
